subject: Add configurable interface font (Options > Appearance)
body:
Add configurable interface font (Options > Appearance)

Adds a "Choose Font" button on the Appearance options page that opens
the standard Windows FontDialog (family, style and size, 6-24pt, no
strikeout/underline). The selection is stored as three new settings
(OptionsAppearancePage.UIFontFamily/UIFontSize/UIFontStyle, default
Segoe UI 8.25 Regular) and applied immediately on save.

New Themes/UIFontManager recursively applies the configured font to
every open form, control, and menu/toolstrip item (including nested
ToolStripDropDownItems), skipping controls that already match to avoid
redundant Font assignments. Applied once at startup from
FrmMain_Load and live on save from AppearancePage.SaveSettings.

triage.rationale: Adds a highly useful, clean accessibility feature allowing user-customized interface fonts without restarting. Worth importing.

votes.concern: Recursive font replacement erases intentional typography and can destabilize DPI-scaled layouts across the entire WinForms interface.
votes.reason: The accessibility idea is useful, but this untested global override conflicts with existing font behavior and requires target-specific redesign, not direct import.

votes.concern: Blanket font apply may break terminals/themed controls; Font instances leak without cache/dispose.
votes.reason: Nice accessibility tweak, but side effects on panels/DPI and leaks need maintainer review first.

dissent: codex: REJECT - The accessibility idea is useful, but this untested global override conflicts with existing font behavior and requires target-specific redesign, not direct import.
grok: NEEDS_HUMAN - Nice accessibility tweak, but side effects on panels/DPI and leaks need maintainer review first.
